in_marathi.name: Vansh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Vansh is a Sanskrit word meaning 'descendant' or 'progeny'. It is derived from the Sanskrit root 'van' which means 'to go' and 'shr' which means 'seed'. This name signifies the continuity of one's lineage and the passing down of one's legacy.
